binding_rules: one publication_outbox row is keyed by effect_id
commit_id is a foreign key to publication_atoms
operational fields do not enter derive_effect_id
leased rows require owner and expiry
non-leased rows have no active lease
acked rows require an acknowledgment receipt root
non-acked rows have no acknowledgment receipt root
transaction_rule: semantic and operational outbox fields are inserted by the same H02 publication transaction
payload_rule: payload_root is the canonical payload reference in this isolated adapter
nonclaims: no worker lease acquisition is implemented
no destination deduplication or receipt provenance is implemented
